name: Post-THR Full Body: Strength, Mobility & Lower Leg
description: 7-day home-based program for 3+ months post-right THR. Uses dumbbells, resistance bands, and static bike. Progressive strength training, hip mobility restoration, lower leg strengthening, ankle stability, QL work, pelvic control, and weekly ROM assessment.

morning.title: Lower Body Strength — Hip Hinge Focus
morning.subtitle: Posterior chain + lower leg loading

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Hinge from hips, slight knee bend. Feel hamstrings and glutes. Keep dumbbells close to legs.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat (Dumbbell)
exercises.notes: Focus on symmetry — do not shift right. Use mirror. Stop before anterior pinch.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Step-Up (Stairs or Low Box)
exercises.notes: Use a sturdy stair or low box. Right leg leads every set. Control the descent.

exercises.name: Banded Standing Hip Abduction
exercises.notes: Band around ankles. Squeeze glute med. Keep pelvis level — no hiking. Hold wall for balance.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise (DB on Knees)
exercises.notes: Sit on chair, place dumbbell on knees. Slow 2-sec hold at top. Targets soleus — key for walking endurance.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise (Bilateral → Single Leg)
exercises.notes: Stand on stair edge, hold wall. Full range — drop heel below step. Hold DB for added load. Targets gastrocnemius.

exercises.name: Tibialis Anterior Raise (Wall Lean)
exercises.notes: Lean back against wall, lift toes toward shins. Slow 2-sec eccentric. Prevents foot slap during gait.

exercises.name: Static Bike
exercises.notes: Moderate resistance. Focus on even pedalling force from both legs. Gait pattern retraining.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.notes: The stretch that improved anterior pinching ~90%. Maintain daily. Posterior pelvic tilt throughout.

exercises.name: Supine Hip IR/ER Rotation (Feet on Wall)
exercises.notes: Hips at 90°, feet on wall. Let knees fall gently inward (IR) and outward (ER). Stop before pain. Track range weekly.

exercises.name: Figure-4 Stretch (Supine)
exercises.notes: Works toward cross-legged sitting goal. Do not force right side. Gentle progressive stretch on deep external rotators.

exercises.name: Side-Lying QL Stretch (Right Side Up)
exercises.notes: Reach right arm overhead, lengthen right side body. Addresses right QL tightness.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Balance (Right Foot)
exercises.notes: Near wall for safety. Eyes open first. Targets right ankle proprioception + wobble control. Progress: eyes closed → pillow/cushion.

exercises.name: Banded Ankle Eversion & Inversion
exercises.notes: Loop band around foot, anchor to table leg. Eversion = peroneals (lateral ankle). Inversion = tibialis posterior (medial ankle). Key for wobbly right ankle.

exercises.name: Towel Toe Scrunches
exercises.notes: Builds intrinsic foot muscles and arch stability. Foundation for ankle stability.

morning.title: Upper Body Push + Core & Pelvic Control
morning.subtitle: Pressing strength + anti-rotation training

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
exercises.notes: Lie on floor, press dumbbells up. Floor limits range — safer for shoulders. Control the eccentric.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Overhead Press
exercises.notes: Sit on sturdy chair. Neutral grip is joint-friendly. Brace core.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: Control the descent, no momentum swinging.

exercises.name: DB Overhead Tricep Extension or Skull Crushers
exercises.notes: Overhead extension standing or skull crushers lying on floor.

exercises.name: Push-Ups (Standard or Incline)
exercises.notes: Incline on chair edge if needed. Rigid body line.

exercises.name: Band Pallof Press
exercises.notes: Anchor band to door handle or sturdy post. Anti-rotation — trains obliques for pelvic control. Addresses rightward squat shift.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.notes: Transverse abdominis + coordination. Keep lower back pinned flat to ground.

exercises.name: Side Plank (Both Sides)
exercises.notes: QL strengthening bilaterally. Build up duration progressively. From knees if needed, progress to full.

evening.title: Light Stretching & Recovery
evening.subtitle: Recovery if feeling stiff, otherwise rest

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.notes: Maintain daily hip flexor stretching to preserve pinching improvement.

exercises.name: Standing Lateral Flexion QL Stretch
exercises.notes: Reach overhead and lean away from the tight side. Gentle.

exercises.name: Wall Calf Stretch (Gastroc + Soleus)
exercises.notes: Straight knee = gastroc. Bent knee = soleus. Both positions important for right ankle.

morning.title: Cardio + Dedicated Lower Leg & Ankle Session
morning.subtitle: Lower leg strengthening + proprioception + cardio

exercises.name: Static Bike
exercises.notes: Moderate intensity. Zone 2 effort. Even pedalling force both legs.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise (Right Focus)
exercises.notes: Hold wall or chair. Build toward unassisted. Hold DB for load. Right leg likely weaker — match reps before progressing.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise (DB on Knees)
exercises.notes: Soleus endurance. Slow tempo, full range.

exercises.name: Tibialis Anterior Raise
exercises.notes: Wall lean. Controls foot during walking swing phase.

exercises.name: Banded Peroneal Strengthening (Eversion)
exercises.notes: Anchor band to table/chair leg. Push foot outward. Targets lateral ankle stability. Key for right ankle wobble.

exercises.name: Banded Tibialis Posterior (Inversion, Plantarflexed)
exercises.notes: Foot slightly pointed down, pull inward against band. Targets arch support + medial ankle.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Balance — Progressive
exercises.notes: Progress: eyes open → eyes closed → pillow/cushion → eyes closed on cushion. Rebuilds right ankle proprioception.

exercises.name: Heel Walks + Toe Walks
exercises.notes: Heel walks = tibialis anterior. Toe walks = calf. Walk along hallway.

exercises.name: Brisk Walk (Outdoors or Indoors)
exercises.notes: Focus on push-off from right foot. Even stride. Gait retraining.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.notes: Daily maintenance. Posterior pelvic tilt throughout.

exercises.name: 90/90 Hip Switches (Gentle)
exercises.notes: Combined hip IR + ER drill. Go to comfortable range only — do not force. Track range improvement weekly.

exercises.name: Supine Adductor Stretch (Butterfly or Frog)
exercises.notes: Works toward cross-legged sitting. Let gravity do the work — no forcing.

exercises.name: Supine Pelvic Tilts
exercises.notes: Anterior/posterior tilting. Builds pelvic awareness and control. Foundation for squat symmetry.

exercises.name: Side-Lying QL Stretch (Right Side Up)
exercises.notes: Lengthen right QL. Breathe into the stretch.

exercises.name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Mobilization (Knee to Wall)
exercises.notes: Improves ankle ROM. Measure distance from wall in cm for progress tracking. Tight ankles contribute to wobble.

morning.title: Upper Body Pull + Core
morning.subtitle: Back, biceps + functional carries for QL

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
exercises.notes: One arm at a time on chair for support, or both arms with flat back. Squeeze shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Band Lat Pulldown (Door Anchor or Overhead Hook)
exercises.notes: Anchor band high on door frame. Pull to collarbone, squeeze shoulder blades. Substitute for lat pulldown machine.

exercises.name: Band Face Pulls
exercises.notes: Anchor band at face height. Pull apart toward face, externally rotate. Rear delts + lower traps.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curls
exercises.notes: Standing. No momentum. Alternate or simultaneous.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shrugs
exercises.notes: Hold at top 1–2 sec. Upper trap strength.

exercises.name: Farmer's Walk (Dumbbells, Hallway/Room)
exercises.notes: Walk back and forth. Core + grip + upright posture. Walk tall, level pelvis.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry (One DB, Each Side)
exercises.notes: QL strengthening through anti-lateral-flexion. Zero side-leaning. Addresses QL weakness bilaterally.

exercises.name: Bird-Dog
exercises.notes: Core stability + glute activation. Keep hips square to ground.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.notes: Daily maintenance stretch.

exercises.name: Seated Upper Trap Stretch
exercises.notes: Gentle guidance, keep shoulders relaxed down.

exercises.name: Doorway Pec Stretch
exercises.notes: Gentle chest opening after pull day. Breathe deeply.

morning.title: Lower Body Strength — Squat Focus
morning.subtitle: Squat symmetry + glutes + adductors + lower leg

exercises.name: Goblet Squat — Depth Focus (Dumbbell)
exercises.notes: Film yourself from front. Watch for rightward shift. Increase depth gradually as symmetry improves.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Split Squat
exercises.notes: Right leg forward — builds single-leg symmetry. Control descent, no forward knee drift.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
exercises.notes: Wide stance, toes out. Targets adductors + glutes. Hold one heavy DB vertically. Home substitute for leg press.

exercises.name: Banded Clamshells (Side-Lying)
exercises.notes: Heavier band than warm-up. Glute med focus. Pelvis stays perpendicular to floor.

exercises.name: Adductor Squeeze (Pillow Between Knees, Supine)
exercises.notes: Use a firm pillow or folded towel. Inner thigh strength — needed for cross-legged sitting goal.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise (Single Leg, DB in Hand)
exercises.notes: Stair edge. Hold wall + DB. Full range. Right leg may need lighter load initially.

exercises.name: Tibialis Anterior Raise
exercises.notes: Consistent lower leg work. Slow eccentric.

exercises.name: Static Bike
exercises.notes: Cool-down pace. Even pedalling, focus on right leg drive.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.notes: Maintain daily. Posterior pelvic tilt throughout.

exercises.name: Supine Hip IR/ER Rotation (Feet on Wall)
exercises.notes: Gentle. Stop before pain. Compare side to side.

exercises.name: Figure-4 Stretch (Supine)
exercises.notes: Cross-legged sitting progression. Gentle on right side.

exercises.name: Side-Lying QL Stretch (Right Side Up)
exercises.notes: Lengthen right QL.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Balance (Right Foot)
exercises.notes: Progress from Monday. Try next difficulty level if stable.

exercises.name: Banded Ankle Eversion & Inversion
exercises.notes: Peroneal + tibialis posterior work for right ankle stability.

exercises.name: Towel Toe Scrunches
exercises.notes: Foot intrinsics. Consistent practice builds arch stability.

exercises.name: Static Bike
exercises.notes: Comfortable Zone 2 pace. Even pedalling both legs.

exercises.name: Suitcase Dumbbell Carry
exercises.notes: Walk tall; zero side-leaning. QL + oblique anti-lateral-flexion.

exercises.name: Push-Ups (Standard or Incline)
exercises.notes: Rigid body line. Light upper-body stimulus.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row (Single Arm, Chair Support)
exercises.notes: Light weight, flawless mechanics. One hand on chair for support.

exercises.name: Banded Standing Hip Abduction
exercises.notes: Technique focus. Level pelvis, no hiking.

exercises.name: Heel Walks + Toe Walks
exercises.notes: Lower leg maintenance. Light and functional.

exercises.name: Band Pallof Press
exercises.notes: Anchor band to door handle. Anti-rotation core brace. Light.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.notes: Daily maintenance.

exercises.name: General Full-Body Stretching
exercises.notes: Calves, hamstrings, QL, hip rotators, chest. Whatever feels tight. Relaxed breathing.

exercises.name: Legs-Up-The-Wall Rest
exercises.notes: Venous blood flow and nervous system recovery.

exercises.name: ROM Test: Hip Flexion (Supine Knee to Chest)
exercises.notes: Lie on back, pull knee to chest gently. Measure fist-widths between knee and chest, or use phone camera for angle. Record both sides. Compare weekly.

exercises.name: ROM Test: Hip Internal Rotation (Seated)
exercises.notes: Sit on bed edge, knees at 90°. Let lower leg swing outward (this is IR). Photo the angle or measure with a ruler from shin to vertical. Record both sides.

exercises.name: ROM Test: Hip External Rotation (Seated)
exercises.notes: Sit on bed edge, knees at 90°. Let lower leg swing inward (this is ER). Photo or measure angle. Record both sides. Key metric for cross-legged sitting goal.

exercises.name: ROM Test: Ankle Dorsiflexion (Knee to Wall)
exercises.notes: Foot facing wall, push knee forward until it touches wall. Measure distance from big toe to wall in cm. Record both sides. Track right ankle progress.

exercises.name: ROM Test: Single-Leg Balance (Timed)
exercises.targetReps: 3 attempts per leg — record best time
exercises.notes: Stand on one leg, time until loss of balance. Eyes open first. Record best of 3. Then try eyes closed. Tracks ankle stability and proprioception progress.

exercises.name: ROM Test: Single-Leg Calf Raise Max Reps
exercises.targetReps: Max reps each leg — record count
exercises.notes: Stand on one leg, do calf raises until failure. Hold wall for balance only. Record reps per side. Tracks lower leg strength recovery.

exercises.name: ROM Test: Squat Symmetry Check (Film)
exercises.targetReps: 5 slow bodyweight squats — film from front
exercises.notes: Set phone on floor filming from front. Do 5 slow squats to comfortable depth. Review for rightward shift. Compare weekly. Note depth achieved.

exercises.name: ROM Test: Pinching Score (0–10)
exercises.notes: Rate your current anterior hip pinching: 0 = none, 10 = worst. Note when it occurs (bending, walking, rest). Record weekly to track trend. Also note walking tolerance — minutes before back stiffness.

exercises.name: Casual Walk (Outdoors if Possible)
exercises.notes: Promotes circulation and joint recovery. Focus on even gait and right foot push-off.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.notes: Daily maintenance — even on rest day.

exercises.name: Standing QL Stretch
exercises.notes: Gentle right side lengthening.

exercises.name: Diaphragmatic Box Breathing
exercises.notes: Calms the central nervous system. Prepares for new training week.
